name: web-green-wavy-layered-ribbon-background
title: Green gradient background with layered wavy ribbon shapes on the left edge
whatItIs: A white background with three overlapping vertical wavy ribbon shapes hugging the left edge, shaded from dark to bright lime green, leaving the right two-thirds empty.
whatItMeans: Fresh and organic; layered waves in one hue feel natural and energetic while keeping most of the canvas free for content.
techniques: Layer several wavy shapes in one colour family for depth.
Anchor decorative shapes to one edge, leaving space free elsewhere.
Vary shade lightness across layers to imply depth.

vocabulary.definition: A smooth undulating form used decoratively.
Several shades and tints of one base hue.
